import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_q_sine (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Real.sin x ≤ x := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_q_sine (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Real.sin x ≤ x
:= by
  have key_sin_le_1 : Real.sin x ≤ 1
  := by
    apply abs_le
    exact Real.sin_x_le_one
    rw [abs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Real.sin_x_nonneg x)]
  have key_sin_le_x : Real.sin x ≤ x
  := by
    apply abs_le
    exact key_sin_le_1
    rw [abs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Real.sin_x_nonneg x)]
    exact key_sin_le_1
  exact key_sin_le_x
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_q_sine = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_q_sine := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.study_q_sine
